title: PCSO hands Php14.3M check to lotto winner after 12-year wait as birthday gift, ahead of Christmas

blocks.text: After spending much of his life working overseas, Antonio F. Mendoza never imagined that the lottery jackpot he won 12 years ago would arrive just when he needed it most, a day before his 59th birthday. On Wednesday, November 25, Mendoza finally received a ₱14.3-million check from Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) General Manager Melquiades A. Robles, ending more than a decade of uncertainty over a partially burned winning ticket. The occasion also marked a first in PCSO history, as Mendoza became the first jackpot winner to publicly reveal his identity during a prize turnover. “Napakasaya. Napakasaya.
